body.name: Finite exact all-future risk certificate
body.construction: For rational \(c\in\mathcal C_K\) and rational \(\eta>0\), enumerate finite rational primal-dual gauge records, compact rational spline records, ordered-real-algebraic response-tube records, and rationalized total Airy-rule records. Use the representation of \(\mathbb A_{\mathrm R}\) by square-free integer polynomials, rational isolating intervals, and Thom-sign data, with exact rational field operations, resultants, Sturm sequences, and certified order comparisons. Return the first finite record \(\Gamma\) containing \(N\), the finite symbolic data, proof-checkable monotone remainder bounds, and code for a total evaluator \(\mathsf{Eval}_{\Gamma}\). On each requested integer \(n\ge N\), the evaluator instantiates the finite prior and estimator records and computes the exact pair \((B_n,U_n)\in\mathbb A_{\mathrm R}^2\) satisfying \(B_n\le R_n(c)\le U_n\) and \(n^{4/3}(U_n-B_n)\le\eta\).
